heroSummary: WJCC Schools begins the 2027–28 school year on Monday, August 23, 2027. The last day of school is Thursday, June 8, 2028, with early release for Pre-K–12 students. Thanksgiving Break runs November 24–26, Winter Break is December 20–31, and Spring Break is April 3–7. Grades 9–12 also have early release June 5–6, followed by Pre-K–12 early release June 7–8.

customSections.label: 2027–28 Calendar Adoption
customSections.content: The WJCC School Board adopted the 2027–28 academic calendar on April 1, 2026. The district said the calendar reflects input from its Academic Calendar Work Group and survey feedback from staff, families, and students.

links.label: Read WJCC's April 1 School Board update

customSections.label: Dates WJCC Families Should Double-Check
customSections.content: These student holidays and grade-specific early releases can be easy to miss in the district calendar.

groups.label: Grade-specific dates
items: November 1–2: student holidays for family conferences.
January 27–28: student holidays while staff have CLP days.
March 31: early release for Pre-K–12 students.
June 7–8: early release for Pre-K–12; June 8 is the last day of school.

customSections.label: What Changed from 2026–27
customSections.content: The main date and schedule changes between WJCC's two published academic calendars.

rows: Pre-K–5 holidays on September 25 and December 11; Pre-K holiday and K–12 early release April 2
Student holidays / staff CLP days on January 27–28; Pre-K–12 early release on March 31

customSections.label: Also Changing in 2027–28
customSections.content: WJCC plans to put new attendance zones into effect in August 2027, the same school year that two dedicated Bright Beginnings Pre-K campuses are expected to open. Families affected by school assignment changes should check WJCC's redistricting updates separately from the academic calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When does WJCC start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Monday, August 23, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is WJCC Thanksgiving Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Thanksgiving Break runs Wednesday, November 24 through Friday, November 26, 2027. Students return Monday, November 29.

calendarFaqs.q: When is WJCC Winter Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: WJCC's published Winter Break runs Monday, December 20 through Friday, December 31, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When do WJCC students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: The next scheduled school day after Winter Break is Monday, January 3, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is WJCC Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, April 3 through Friday, April 7, 2028. Students return Monday, April 10.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for WJCC in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Thursday, June 8, 2028, with early release for Pre-K–12 students.

calendarFaqs.q: When are WJCC early-release days near the end of 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 9–12 have early release June 5–6. Pre-K–12 students have early release June 7–8, and June 8 is the last day of school.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 16, 2026, against WJCC Schools' 2027–28 academic calendar PDF, calendar page, April 1 School Board update, and redistricting page.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we reviewed the WJCC calendar
sourceReviewDetails: Confirmed the August 23 first day, June 8 last day, Thanksgiving, Winter and Spring Break ranges, family-conference days, CLP days, holidays, and grade-specific early releases against the academic calendar PDF adopted April 1, 2026.
Checked the calendar's adoption context against WJCC's April 1 School Board meeting update, published April 3, 2026.

Checked the August 2027 attendance-zone implementation and two planned Bright Beginnings campuses against WJCC's redistricting page; those assignment changes are separate from the academic calendar dates.
The downloadable ICS file is a one-time import generated from the reviewed dates. It does not update automatically if WJCC changes the calendar.
